study.title: Deep Learning-Driven Automatic Segmentation of Weeds and Crops in UAV Imagery
study.short_title: UAV SRR+segmentation (tobacco): ensemble mIoU 90.75; RCAN SRR PSNR 24.98 dB

segmentation.domain: UAV-based super-resolution reconstruction (SRR) coupled with semantic segmentation to discriminate weeds from tobacco (Nicotiana tabacum) in plantation-scale imagery (Yunnan, China); systematically evaluates CNN, Transformer (DPT+DINOv2) and Mamba (ChangeMamba+VMamba) architectures plus an ensemble
models_tested: FPN/UNet/DeepLabV3+/UNet++/MA-Net with EfficientNet-b5, ResNeXt101_32x8d and ResNet101 backbones
SRR models: SRCNN, SRFBN, EDSR, RDN, RCAN between: retained
segmentation.best_model: Ensemble (17+19+20+22) achieves mIoU 90.75% on the HR test set (IoU green/background 94.90, white/weeds 81.43, brown/tobacco 95.91); best single model DPT+DINOv2(vit_b) mIoU 90.18%; best Mamba ChangeMamba+VMamba(base) 89.69%; best CNN UNet+++ResNeXt101 87.97%. SRR: RCAN best (PSNR 24.98 dB, SSIM 69.48%); RDN 89.18% mIoU at 4x magnification after SRR

dataset.name: Publicly released annotated UAV tobacco-field dataset (Yunnan, Tonghai County): ~840 HR image patches (256x256) of tobacco plantations with 3-class pixel labels - land/green background, weed or other vegetation (white), and tobacco (brown); DJI Mini 3 drone (248 g, 38 min flight, 82.1 deg FOV, 4000x3000 px) at 3 m altitude; 735 train / 105 test (augmented x30 to 22,050 / 3,150)
dataset.note: Orthophoto subdivided by sliding window (patch 256, stride 32). Low-resolution counterparts synthesized as 64x64 via degradation model (motion blur + bicubic downsampling + Gaussian noise). LabelMe annotation with two independent experts + farmer review. Also evaluated on true 10 m-altitude UAV imagery: mIoU 75.12% -> 79.85% after RCAN SRR enhancement. 4x magnification found optimal.

segmentation.backbone: Ensemble of UNet+SegFormer(mit_b5), DPT+DINOv2(vit_l/vit_b), ChangeMamba+VMamba(base); probability averaging with uniform weights + H/V flip TTA; SRR front-end: RCAN (residual channel attention) as the top reconstruction model

mIoU.quote: the ensemble model integrating Transformer (DPT with DINOv2) and Mamba-based architectures achieved the highest mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) of 90.75%
mIoU.ambiguity: Ensemble model on native HR test set (3 classes: background 94.90, weeds 81.43, tobacco 95.91). Best single model DPT+DINOv2(vit_b) 0.9018. On 4x-downsampled+RCAN SRR test set mIoU 0.8918 (Table 2 vs. Bicubic baseline 0.8279).

mPA.ambiguity: Per-class IoU reported instead of class-mean accuracy.

F1.ambiguity: F1 not reported (IoU and mIoU used).

Dice.ambiguity: Dice not reported (IoU and mIoU used).

weed_F1.ambiguity: Weed class reported as IoU (white class 81.43%); no per-class F1.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Tobacco class reported as IoU (brown class 95.91%); no per-class F1.

edge.device: NVIDIA Tesla V100 32 GB (segmentation training) and RTX 4090 (SRR + SRR experiments) server, Ubuntu 20.04

fps.quote: the inference speed of the ensemble segmentation model under this study's experimental setting is approximately 2.5 images per second for 256 x 256 inputs
fps.ambiguity: Ensemble (4 sub-models + TTA) throughput on server GPU, edge.reported=false; SRR per-patch inference: SRCNN/EDSR ~1.5 ms, SRFBN 2 ms, RDN 5 ms, RCAN >8 ms. On-board UAV real-time is only discussed as future work (pruning/quantization/Jetson).

latency_ms.quote: For segmentation models, the inference speed of the ensemble segmentation model under this study's experimental setting is approximately 2.5 images per second for 256 x 256 inputs
latency_ms.ambiguity: Derived from 2.5 images/s ensemble throughput (~400 ms/image) on desktop/server GPU - NOT an edge measurement. Note SRR adds further per-patch cost (RCAN >8 ms) in the full pipeline.

issues: Ensemble of 4 heterogeneous models (SegFormer, DPT+DINOv2 x2, VMamba) with uniform-weight probability averaging + flip TTA; no single compact deployment model, and ensemble is heavy (~2.5 img/s).
edge.reported=false: all inference on V100/RTX 4090 server; on-board UAV deployment only discussed as future work (pruning/quantization/Jetson TX2 class hardware).
Primary metrics on the native HR test set (mIoU 0.9075); SRR recovery on 4x-downsampled input reaches mIoU 0.8918 (RCAN, Table 2), closing most of the gap vs HR.
10 m-altitude real-world test: mIoU 75.12 -> 79.85 after RCAN SRR. Optimal magnification 4x. Latency for ensemble derived from reported throughput.
